verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a law firm offering legal advisory services. It is not a software product or platform where users store data, so self-service export of user data in open formats is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm offers a user data store or export tool that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
